tasks.label: Release: dry run
tasks.detail: Validate and show what a release would change. Changes nothing.

tasks.label: Release: bump, tag (no push)
tasks.detail: Run the CI checks, bump the version, commit and tag locally. Asks before changing anything.

tasks.label: Release: bump, tag and push
tasks.detail: Run the CI checks, bump the version, commit, tag and push main + the tag. Asks before changing anything.

tasks.label: Check: everything CI checks
tasks.command: cargo test -p rdbatch-core --locked; cargo test -p rdbatch-desktop --locked; pnpm check; pnpm test; node scripts/check-i18n.mjs

inputs.description: New version: patch, minor, major, or an exact X.Y.Z (prerelease: numeric only, e.g. 0.4.0-1)
